convert_dataframe_to_dict: convert a pandas DataFrame to a dictionary using orient='dict' with column-to-index mappings
convert_dataframe_to_records: convert a pandas DataFrame to a list of row dictionaries with orient='records'
convert_dataframe_to_split: convert a pandas DataFrame to split format with index, columns, and data arrays
convert_dataframe_to_tight: convert a pandas DataFrame to tight format including index_names and column_names metadata
convert_dataframe_to_index: convert a pandas DataFrame to index-keyed dictionary with orient='index' for unique indices
